findings.current: Tu inscripción sigue activa para esta cuenta y tus otros equipos.
findings.proposed: Tu inscripción sigue activa para esta cuenta y tus otros dispositivos.
findings.reason: «equipo» is the glossary's term for team (ui.teamBridge.page.subtitle, ui.agents.refusals.*), and this sentence, unlike the adjacent switch label «Activado en este equipo», admits the team reading of «tus otros equipos»; «dispositivo» is the glossary's device term and shipped es already uses it for a device (ui.mesh.mesh_actions.this_device_keeps). The switch label itself is acceptable: «este equipo» for a computer is established Spanish UI usage and the same feature's shipped dialog (ui.agentMessages.dialog.local_failure) already uses it.

«inclusión» names the act of including, not the included items, so the label is a literal calque the context note does not support: it defines the option as selecting the whole catalog, and «catálogo» is the term this namespace already uses for it (ui.library.page.building, ui.library.page.load_failed). The shorter form is also 16 characters against the current 21, in a rail that renders a count beside it.

This sort option orders assets by each asset's own organized.at (library-model.ts:289-290), so it must agree with its sibling sort label «Vistos recientemente»; the current singular reads as the library-wide last organize run, which is the separate librarian.last_organized string.

findings.proposed: Se copió el ID del recurso
findings.reason: The masculine participle «copiado» agrees with «recurso», so the toast first parses as «ID of the copied asset» rather than «the asset ID was copied»; the sentence form matches the action's actual object.

findings.proposed: keep the current text; run a rendered check at sidebar width (composed link_down_compact renders «Sin conexión · hace 4 min», 25 cells against 18 in English)
findings.reason: The context caps this as a compact fragment for narrow sidebar rows; rendered at 4 it is 10 characters against 6 («4m ago»), and the composed sidebar fact grows from 18 to 25 cells (+39%). No shorter grammatical Spanish form exists («4 min» loses the ago reading), so this is a rendered-check flag rather than a text change.
